title: Emergent Multi-View Geometry Through Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39227v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Over a century ago, Henri Poincar\'e argued that a motionless observer cannot acquire the notion of space. Yet, most visual representation learning methods operate on individual images, while those that leverage multiple views rely on RGB reconstruction, entangling geometry with appearance. We propose Poincar3, a self-supervised method that learns representations from multiple views through self-distillation instead of RGB reconstruction. We combine masked patch and image-level distillation with a teacher that observes additional views, enabling training from scratch without explicit 3D supervision. Poincar3 outperforms both previous single and multi-view self-supervised approaches such as DINOv3, MuM, and Muskie on correspondence estimation, camera pose estimation, and 3D reconstruction. translated_title: 通过自蒸馏涌现的多视图几何
translated_abstract: 一个多世纪前，昂利·庞加莱曾论证：静止不动的观察者无法获得空间的概念。然而，大多数视觉表征学习方法仅处理单张图像，而那些利用多视图的方法则依赖RGB重建，将几何与外观纠缠在一起。我们提出Poincar3，一种通过自蒸馏而非RGB重建从多视图学习表征的自监督方法。我们将掩码补丁和图像级蒸馏与能观察额外视图的教师网络相结合，使得无需显式3D监督即可从零开始训练。Poincar3在对应点估计、相机位姿估计和3D重建任务上超越了以往的单视图和多视图自监督方法，如DINOv3、MuM和Muskie。借助一个轻量级的庞加莱适配器，我们还发现所学特征比现有自监督表征更准确地编码了相机运动。
tldr: Poincar3提出了一种通过自蒸馏而非RGB重建从多视图学习视觉表征的自监督方法，无需显式3D监督即可涌现出多视图几何能力，在对应点估计、相机位姿估计和3D重建任务上超越了DINOv3等现有方法。
en_tdlr: Poincar3 is a self-supervised method that learns multi-view representations through self-distillation instead of RGB reconstruction, achieving emergent multi-view geometry without explicit 3D supervision and outperforming DINOv3, MuM, and Muskie on correspondence estimation, camera pose estimation, and 3D reconstruction tasks.
